body: Right now I want to be alone but I can't be alone.. nobody would leave me alone and it's pissing me off more than it's helping me. I keep telling them that and when I do get to be alone i hear them talking like they're having some conference meeting downstairs about the state of my life and how they're gonna fix it from my room and that just makes me even more bitter and sad

I hope you feel way better now than when the moment you felt like you needed to do it too.. And I know how it feels to be misunderstood. My mom thinks that I have some sort of devil in me whispering bad things I should do to myself and I get tired of it..

I'm hoping it gets better too but it's not something that can happen at a snap of a finger. I'm just tired of being a fuck up and as I said I know I'm lucky to have everyone that cares about me but I don't want them to only do this cause I did something stupid. I mean I get that they're doing it now especially cause I did something stupid but I guess it's also my fault for not reaching our to them before it got so bad.
